info.title: Public endpoint exposes order tokens (not PII but identifiers)
info.description: CDSOrderDetailsResource exposes 'token' field. Tokens are random short codes (no customer identity embedded), used by the customer to retrieve their order via /order/{token}. Public-by-design — no PII implication — but worth noting that a malicious watcher could enumerate active tokens from the public OSS feed and attempt to deep-link an order page. Order detail pages have their own access controls (per OrderRequest::authorize tokenCan kiosk:order).
